scope_symbols: related parsing helpers and command dispatch
invariants: Missing/failed sources and pages remain explicit.
Terminal response alone cannot hide earlier gaps.
Appearances, IDs, hidden counts and unavailable placeholders remain distinct.
Cached evidence is not represented as a fresh fetch.

findings.invariant: A missing middle page cannot be reported as exhausted channel pagination.
findings.observed: valid examines only the terminal raw response, recorded error flags and continuation_remaining.

counterexample.scenario: Derived channel catalog has pages 0 and 2; page 1 is absent. Its retained terminal response has no continuation.
counterexample.expected: Incomplete channel snapshot; missing page 1 must be reported.

findings.smallest_repair: Require consecutive page indexes and per-page raw evidence/ID agreement; validate primary-list continuation closure while accounting separately for known non-video branches.
findings.focused_observer: observer.py R02-01 must return an incomplete/error result after repair; retain acceptance of the complete actual channel page sequences.
findings.current_data_impact: No current missing-video evidence: all 120 retained response pages agree with the derived ordered IDs and branch-aware continuation checks.

findings.invariant: Every declared source must remain visible, including sources without a state file.
findings.observed: A core playlist is added only when its state.json exists.

counterexample.scenario: Only Casanare has a state file; four other declared core playlists were never crawled. Both channel fixtures are valid.
counterexample.expected: Every declared core source appears, with an explicit missing/not-started status for uncrawled sources.

findings.smallest_repair: Preserve the expected source set and emit incomplete/missing entries for absent required sources; record explicitly requested optional sources.
findings.focused_observer: observer.py R02-02 must include all four missing core keys with incomplete statuses after repair.
findings.current_data_impact: All ten selected playlist states are present in the published snapshot and reconcile; this snapshot does not trigger the omission.

exclusions: Substantive video/transcript matching and Casanare admission
Fresh network enumeration and unavailable content
Original retrieval timestamps and request-token submission provenance
mutations: Only this review directory; no baseline, production, shared-cache or remote mutations.
